tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the parchment (light) or the dungeon stone (dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quest cards, journal entries, input fields laid on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: sidebar, progress tracks, tab background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` (≥ 11:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (quest giver, location, session date) on all three surfaces (≥ 5.4:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control borders (fields, secondary buttons, objective boxes) — ≥ 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules and card dividers. Never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Brand colour — the wax of the seal. Primary button, drop cap, failed quest. Crimson text readable on all three surfaces (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: crimson-deep
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of the primary button.

tokens.name: on-crimson
tokens.usage: Text on a `crimson` or `crimson-deep` fill (8:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Decorative gilding: ornaments, selected-card rule, rarity stars. In the light theme, never for text (2.7:1) — use `gold-ink`.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold text: rewards (po, XP), legendary rank. On `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥ 5.6:1).

tokens.name: arcane
tokens.usage: Magic and ongoing action: active quest, links, focus ring. Readable as text on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Completed quest, checked objective. Always paired with the ✓ glyph and a word — cannot be told apart from `crimson` by hue alone.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Urgency: quest with a deadline, imminent danger. Text on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥ 4.5:1); kept apart from `crimson` (failed) and `gold-ink` (reward), which it sits next to.

tokens.name: rep-hostile
tokens.usage: Reputation Hostile / Haï. Fill of the `Reputation` label (`surface` text on it) and diamond of the current step; also readable as text. ≥ 4.5:1 (AA) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` in Parchment, ≥ 7.2:1 in Dungeon.

tokens.name: rep-cold
tokens.usage: Reputation Inamical / Méfiant. Fill of the `Reputation` label (`surface` text on it) and diamond of the current step; also readable as text. ≥ 4.5:1 (AA) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` in Parchment, ≥ 7.2:1 in Dungeon.

tokens.name: rep-neutral
tokens.usage: Reputation Indifférent / Ignoré. Fill of the `Reputation` label (`surface` text on it) and diamond of the current step; also readable as text. ≥ 4.5:1 (AA) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` in Parchment, ≥ 7.2:1 in Dungeon.

tokens.name: rep-warm
tokens.usage: Reputation Amical / Apprécié. Fill of the `Reputation` label (`surface` text on it) and diamond of the current step; also readable as text. ≥ 4.5:1 (AA) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` in Parchment, ≥ 7.2:1 in Dungeon.

tokens.name: rep-ally
tokens.usage: Reputation Serviable / Vénéré. Fill of the `Reputation` label (`surface` text on it) and diamond of the current step; also readable as text. ≥ 4.5:1 (AA) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` in Parchment, ≥ 7.2:1 in Dungeon.

tokens.name: secret
tokens.usage: Restricted visibility: « Secret MJ » or « Partagé avec… » badge and frame. Reserved for that meaning. Text ≥ 7.5:1 on all three surfaces in both themes, and ≥ 7.5:1 over `secret-hatch` on `surface-raised`; always with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: secret-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatching of restricted content (Secret MJ, shared with some players). Decoration only, never under long text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, offset by 2px. ≥ 5.7:1 on every surface, in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Campaign title, home screen. Once per screen.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title: an open quest, a chapter.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Quest card and journal entry title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: La brume se leva sur les marais quand la cloche sonna.
styles.usage: Long text of the session journal.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Retrouver le médaillon volé à la prêtresse.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: « Celui qui porte la clé porte aussi la malédiction. »

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between glyph and label in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between objectives, between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of controls, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of quest cards and journal entries.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins, breathing room around the campaign title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, objective boxes (as diamonds), fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, quest cards, journal entries.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modal windows, side panels.

tokens.name: size-tag
tokens.usage: Height of the small framed tags, border included: Badge, item count in RewardSummary, rarity in RewardList, Visibility markers (objective lines included). ContactChip keeps its own 23px.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Quest cards and journal entries at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: Hovered or dragged card, modals.
